source_url.category_hint: Australian department store. Homewares, furniture, bedding, appliances & kitchenware → Home. TVs, audio & gaming → Entertainment. Cosmetics & skincare → Beauty. Clothing → Womens, Menswear or Kids (use product keywords). Toys, games, scooters & hoverboards → Toys. Pet food, pet accessories, groceries, luggage & travel accessories → Others. Always prioritize product keywords over sale terms. Promotions mentioning both Home and Clothing (e.g. 'Clothing & Home Clearance') → Home. Use Others only for promotions with no identifiable product category.
